propositions: Coverage instrumentation is currently collected identically on all three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13), adding ~34 seconds of wall-time overhead per uninstrumented cell without distinct verdicts since production code has no version-specific branches

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the single primary coverage cell to collect branch coverage and enforce fail_under, while Python 3.11, 3.12, and macOS 3.13 retain all tests but run uninstrumented
The workflow contract test must verify that all four matrix cells retain both default and integration pytest tiers, exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags, and no other cell receives them

Django, NumPy, and SciPy all use selective single-cell or dedicated-job coverage collection for their primary configurations while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing precedent

The change requires updates to the coverage rationale comment in the workflow YAML and canonical topology documentation to reflect one-cell coverage, with defect-seeding tests that verify the prior all-Ubuntu and zero-coverage conditions fail
